correctness.rationale: By the literal 2-parent descendant condition, a failure is witnessed by two parents and one other word tied with or closer than the nearest parent. Therefore all triple constraints suffice for any larger code. Reconstructed an independent Python exhaustive algorithm using the 64 quaternary words, literal Hamming metric and descendant generation: exactly 14,016 of 41,664 triples compatible and exactly 27,696 of 635,376 four-subsets valid. Every potential five-code has a sorted four-prefix in that maximum list and a larger fifth vertex; exhaustive extension found none, so optimum is four. Independently closed all maxima under nine adjacent symbol transpositions plus two adjacent coordinate swaps generating S4^3 ⋊ S3: seven disjoint orbits of sizes 48,288,576,2592,3456,10368,10368, which sum to 27,696. Dividing 82,944 by sizes gives stabilizers. The finite universe is exhausted, unlike partial sampling. Source code and its canonical-census digest were inspected, but its digest was not independently reproduced in this audit.
